name: A Daughter's Love
summary: Sarah Ladimore asks you to bring her ring to Morgan Ladimore’s grave. The meeting there bears on Morgan’s troubled soul.

sections.title: At the Grave
sections.body: A voice on the wind answers when you bring Sarah Ladimore’s ring to Morgan Ladimore’s grave. Morgan wonders whether Sarah still lives, and says the ring lifts a weight from his shoulders. He entrusts you with his sword, Archeus, and asks you to keep the ring as he speaks to Lys, his love.

faq.q: What happens when I take Sarah’s ring to Morgan’s grave?
faq.answer: A voice on the wind responds. Morgan wonders if Sarah is still alive and says the ring lifts a weight from his shoulders.

faq.q: Who is the voice at the grave?
faq.answer: Morgan Ladimore speaks as a ghostly voice on the wind.
Morgan gives you his sword, Archeus.

faq.q: What does Morgan ask me to keep?
faq.answer: Morgan asks you to keep Sarah’s ring.

angles.text: Morgan says Archeus was forged to do good and asks you to carry on the Light through it.
